entries.note: The first event of every shipment: WARP has the order, before a driver takes it.
A driver has taken the load. Also a shipment status, which WARP's apps label Booked.
The driver is on the way to collect the freight, which the sender still holds.
The driver is at the sender's dock; the freight is not loaded yet. Also a shipment status, labelled Arrived at Pickup.
The loaded truck has left for the consignee; the tracking page files it under Out for Delivery.
The truck is at the consignee, before the delivery is confirmed. Also a shipment status, labelled Arrived at Dropoff.
The shipment status of a delivered shipment; the tracking page shows it as Delivered.
The event of a canceled shipment, and its shipment status.
An event the tracking page files under pickup, after the driver's arrival: the freight is loaded.
An event the tracking page files under transit.
An event the tracking page files under facility: the freight is at one of WARP's cross-docks.
An event the tracking page files under facility.
An event the tracking page files under facility, unless its title is Out for delivery.
The tracking page files a departure under this title as out for delivery: the last leg has left the cross-dock.
An event the tracking page files under exception.
The driver could not collect the freight. An event and a shipment status; the label is the status's.
The driver could not deliver; the tracking page shows it among the delivery events.
An event the tracking page files under exception.
An event and a shipment status: the freight went back to the sender.
An event and a shipment status: the freight was disposed of.
The shipment status of a new order before a driver takes it; the tracking page shows Order created.
A shipment status; the tracking page shows Pickup Scheduled.
A shipment status; the tracking page shows Picked Up.
A shipment status; the tracking page shows Out for Delivery.
A shipment status, on the way to a cross-dock.
A shipment status, at a cross-dock.
A shipment status, after a cross-dock.
A shipment status of a delivery made.
A shipment status of a delivery not made.
A shipment status: the freight is going back to the sender.
A shipment status; the tracking page shows Return Initiated.
A shipment status; the tracking page shows Return Initiated.
A shipment status.
A shipment status.
A shipment status taken off the order; the tracking page shows Canceled.
An appointment notice the tracking page files apart from the shipment's progress; it keeps the stage of the event before it.
